# dwic — design with claude

> dwic ("dwick", d + wi + c = design with claude) is a design auditor that runs inside Claude Code. An MCP server + browser companion for code-first designers: audit your design system, preserve intent across sessions, and render Claude's design outputs live.

## What it is

dwic is distributed as the npm package `@imrandwc/dwic`. Install it once, and Claude Code gains 14 design specialists that can audit or generate palettes, type scales, spacing ramps, component specs, and copy. A browser companion at designwithclaude.com stores your project profile (framework, stack, design system, tone) and renders structured outputs live as Claude produces them.

A zero-friction CLI audit is also available — no install, no account:

```
npx @imrandwc/dwic audit
```

Scans the current project, runs 8 audit categories (color, typography, spacing, accessibility, form, navigation, motion, copy), prints a severity-sorted dashboard, writes a shareable report to `.dwic/audit-<date>.md`. Exit code mirrors severity (0 clean, 1 warn, 2 error) so it slots into CI.

## Install (full MCP product)

```
npx @imrandwc/dwic setup --token=imr_xxx --project=<slug>
```

Get a token by starting at [designwithclaude.com/start](https://designwithclaude.com/start) — a 5-step wizard mints the token and generates a tailored CLAUDE.md for your project.

## Core surfaces

- [Homepage](https://designwithclaude.com/): product overview, interactive audit demo, install flow.
- [Start](https://designwithclaude.com/start): onboarding wizard; mints your token; generates CLAUDE.md.
- [Library](https://designwithclaude.com/library): the V1 library — 44 role-based design specialists as Claude Code slash commands (standalone or plugin).

## MCP tools (14 active)

Audit + generate modes: `color-specialist`, `typography-specialist`, `spacing-specialist`, `design-system-architect`, `accessibility-specialist`, `form-designer`, `navigation-specialist`, `content-strategist`, `motion-designer`.

Generate only: `design-brief`, `setup-guide`, `debug-helper`, `set-project-profile`, `design-next-step` (synthesizes your profile + recent events into a single named next step).

## Positioning

dwic is the design-engineering rigor layer for code-first designers using Claude Code — audit, drift detection, persistent project memory. It complements canvas tools (including Claude Design) rather than competing with them.
